chunks: (The Pharaoh) said: "Your apostle who has been sent to you, is certainly mad."
ai.seo_question: What did Pharaoh say about Prophet Musa?
ai.summary: In Surah Al-Shu'ara, Pharaoh dismisses Musa (AS) as a madman to delegitimize his prophetic mission and maintain political control, a classic motif of tyrannical rejection. This declaration underscores the psychological warfare employed by oppressors against divine messengers, framing truth as insanity to preserve the status quo.
